caption:
Your customers now ask AI before they ask Google.

BrightLocal's 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey found AI tools jumped from 6% to 45% of local business discovery in a single year, while Google's share slipped from 83% to 71%.

42% of consumers say they trust an AI recommendation as much as a written review.

Here's what that means for your shop: AI answers pull from your full review corpus, weighing recency and volume alongside your star rating. A business with new reviews landing every week reads as active. One with a pile from last year reads as done.

Steady review flow just became a discovery requirement.
